title: Whirling knight's tours with n coils and with the least number of coils
scope: n coils: nonexistence for all n >= 5 not divisible by 4; explicit tours for the multiples of 4 from 12 to 48; n >= 28 quoted from Knuth's draft. Lower bound: at least n/2 + 2 coils for n = 4, 6 (mod 8) and at least (n+3)/2 coils for odd n >= 5 not congruent to 1, 19 (mod 24). Least number of coils for every n >= 12 with n not congruent to 3 (mod 4): n/2 for n = 0, 2 (mod 8), n/2 + 2 for n = 4, 6 (mod 8), (n+1)/2 for n = 1 (mod 24), (n+3)/2 for the other n = 1 (mod 4), with tours from explicit lists (n <= 95) and a ring construction from eighteen seed tours (n >= 96). n = 3 (mod 4): tours attaining the bounds for 11 <= n <= 119 only.
gate_basis: Exact verification scripts pass (verify_weights.py for 5 <= n <= 70; check_tour.py on all tour files; lower_bounds.py for even n <= 500 and odd n <= 301; half_family.py: 63 explicit tours, conditions (Z),(S),(W),(C) for eighteen seeds, direct checks of every n not congruent to 3 (mod 4) from 96 to 573 and of n = 1000, 1001). Independent AI referee passes re-implemented the checks from the text. Referee passes on 2026-11-16, each given only the paper and data files: a third found no mathematical error in the n/2-coil construction; a fourth found no error in the lower-bound section or in the n/2 + 2 families beyond one misstated proposition for the 3 x 3 board, now corrected. A fifth found no error in the families for odd n = 1 (mod 4) or in the two propositions added last, and two misstatements, now corrected. No external review.
dependencies: Python 3.10+ standard library for check_tour.py and verify_weights.py.
python-sat (CaDiCaL), numpy, scipy and matplotlib for the search, LP and figure scripts.
limitations: Not externally peer reviewed. Checks so far: exact verification scripts, and independent re-implementations from the text of the paper by separate AI agents. Referee passes on 2026-11-16, each given only the paper and data files: a third found no mathematical error in the n/2-coil construction; a fourth found no error in the lower-bound section or in the n/2 + 2 families beyond one misstated proposition for the 3 x 3 board, now corrected. A fifth found no error in the families for odd n = 1 (mod 4) or in the two propositions added last, and two misstatements, now corrected.

n coils: the existence direction for n >= 28 is quoted from Knuth's draft (answer 232, Beluhov and Stappers) and was not re-derived; tours for multiples of 4 up to 48 are supplied independently. The cases n = 4 and n = 8 rest on exhaustive enumeration (Knuth's counts, reproduced by whirl_sat.py).

Least number of coils: the lower bound has a complete written proof. The existence proof is computer-assisted: the eighteen seeds were found by SAT search, and the proof for all n rests on a lemma plus finite conditions that half_family.py checks. The cases n = 8, 10 of exercise 231(a) are covered by two small labelled wedges, and also by Knuth's counts.

n = 3 (mod 4): only the lower bound is proved. That it is attained is shown by explicit tours for n from 11 to 119; the general case is open. The least number of coils for n = 8, 9 rests on exhaustive enumeration (ours and Knuth's counts), and for n = 10 on the SAT search.

We found no published construction for n/2 coils, but cannot rule out that one is known to others (Beluhov, Stappers) and unpublished. Knuth's site was unreachable on 2026-11-16, so we could not check for a newer draft.
The n-coil proof technique (closed-form Farkas certificates for a cycle-cover LP relaxation) follows S. Li, arXiv:2605.04603. Li's theorem on n/2 coils is reproved here by a different method.
Knuth's draft is cited, not reproduced. Priority has not been established by an external party.
